channel.title: Exact incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Exact's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Exact Online – Payment batches are not matched automatically via Exact PSD2 link for ING. [investigating]
item.description: You may experience that payment batches executed via an Exact PSD2 bank link for ING are not matched automatically based on the payment batch ID. We are investigating the issue. As soon as more information becomes available we will update this page. Our apologies for the inconvenience.

item.title: Exact Boekhoud Gemak - Error loading large general ledger accounts (NL) [identified]
item.description: You may experience issues loading information on the "Info and Reports" screen ("Info en rapportage") in Exact Boekhoud Gemak. We have identified the issue and are currently working on a solution. We will update this page as soon as more information is available. Our apologies for the inconvenience.

item.title: Exact Multivers Online / Exact Boekhoud Gemak - No export possible through ODBC (NL) [resolved]
item.description: The issues have been resolved. You are able to use ODBC to export data again. If issues still occur, please do not hesitate to contact Support. Our apologies for the inconvenience.

item.title: Exact Reeleezee – Rabobank Payment and Direct Debit Orders Not Submitted (NL) [investigating]
item.description: Payment and direct debit orders submitted through a Rabobank PSD2 bank links may incorrectly show the status "File rejected by bank" after the authorization of a PSD2 bank link has been renewed or changes have been made to the services of a Rabobank connection. As a result, affected orders have not been received by the bank. In addition, affected PSD2 bank links may incorrectly be displayed as a Rabo Boekhoudkoppeling. As a possible workaround, customers can try to renew the bank link again. We are currently investigating issue and we will update this page once more information becomes available. Our apologies for the inconvenience.

item.title: Exact Online Premium – System unavailable (NL) [resolved]
item.description: This issue has been resolved. Our apologies for the inconvenience.

item.title: Exact Multivers Online / Exact Boekhoud Gemak - Bank statements not delivered for ABN AMRO and ING Bank (NL) [resolved]
item.description: The issues have been resolved. All related bank mutations have been imported. If issues still occur please do not hesitate to contact Support. Our apologies for the inconvenience.

item.title: Exact Online - Planboard and Outlook synchronisation issues (NL/BE) [investigating]
item.description: You may experience issues when synchronizing the plan board in Exact Online with your Outlook agenda. This includes, but is not limited to a "Due incorrect login information it is not possible to send modifications to the personal agenda's of X employees. Due to technical issues it is not possible to send modifications to the personal agenda of X employees." error. We are investigating the issue. We will update this page once more information becomes available. Our apologies for the inconvenience.

item.title: Exact Bouw - No purchase invoices imported from Basecone (NL/BE) [resolved]
item.description: This issue has been resolved and all invoices have been imported in the meantime. New invoices are imported without delay in Exact Online Bouw. Our apologies for the inconvenience.

item.title: Exact Online Fiscaal - 504 Gateway Time-out when logging in (NL) [resolved]
item.description: This issue has been resolved. Our apologies for the inconvenience.

item.title: Exact Multivers Online - Issues when resetting your user account (NL) [investigating]
item.description: You may not receive a password reset e-mail upon request and you may get a white screen when trying to set up your Multi-factor Authentication. We are investigating this issue, and we will update this page as soon as more information becomes available. Our apologies for the inconvenience.

item.title: Exact Online – Duplicate transactions via Exact PSD2 bank link for ABN AMRO (NL) [resolved]
item.description:
It is possible that statements for Payment Batches which have been processed via an Exact PSD2 link for ABN AMRO have been imported twice. This could have happend only once per bank account between September 4th and September 10th. The root cause has been identified and measures have been taken to prevent this issue from happening again in the future.
In order to resolve the issue, you can delete the duplicate statement (that has not yet been matched). For more information on how to delete duplicate statements, you can consult our Support Agent via the question mark icon in the top-right corner of your screen. Our apologies for the inconvenience.

item.title: Exact Online (Premium) - Import may result in OOPS error (NL/BE/ES) [resolved]
item.description: This issue has been resolved. Our apologies for the inconvenience.

item.title: Exact Online Bouw - Data is not synchronizing between Exact Online Bouw and connected applications (NL/BE) [resolved]
item.description: This issue has been resolved and all related data has been synchronized. Our apologies for the inconvenience.

item.title: Exact Reeleezee – Direct debit and payment batches cannot be sent via Rabo BoekhoudKoppeling (NL) [resolved]
item.description: The issue has been resolved. It is possible again to send payment- and direct debit files from Reeleezee via the automatic bank link with Rabobank. Our apologies for the inconvenience.

item.title: Exact Online - Performance issues in Exact Online (NL) [resolved]
item.description: This issue has been resolved. Our apologies for the inconvenience.

item.title: Exact Online Fiscaal - Declarations are rejected with a general rejection reason (NL) [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved. Logius has restored the Digipoort service, and declarations are being processed normally again. Our apologies for the inconvenience.

item.title: Exact Synergy - Word pop-up blocked in 64-bit (Global) [investigating]
item.description: You may notice that the Exact Synergy add-in blocks Word pop-ups when working in 64-bit. We are investigating this issue. This page will be updated as soon as more information becomes available. Our apologies for the inconvenience.

item.title: Exact Multivers / Exact Boekhoud Gemak - Rabobank mutations not received (NL) [resolved]

item.title: Exact Gripp - Emails delayed or not getting delivered to Microsoft mail-domains (NL/BE) [resolved]

item.title: Exact Reeleezee – Rabobank Bank Transaction Import Delay [resolved]
item.description:
This issue has been resolved. The transactions from the affected period have now been successfully imported for most customers. For a small number of customers, the remaining transactions are expected to be imported later today. If you notice that some historical transactions are still missing tomorrow, you can retrieve them manually.
First, please try selecting "Retrieve Transactions" via "Manage Bank Connection" from your bank account settings in Reeleezee. If the missing transactions are still not displayed, you can download a CAMT.053 file containing the missing transactions from your online banking environment and import it into Reeleezee via the bank overview. Our apologies for the inconvenience.
